$comment: Who can act in the workbench. Fictional people for the prototype; roles are what matter. policy-author starts changes, policy-reviewer gives the policy approval, engineer gives the engineering approval, publishes, and builds requests. Two engineers, because the engineering approval must come from an engineer who is not the author: with one, a change an engineer starts could never be published. translator gives the translation approval, on changes that add or change words on the screens, once every string has Spanish.
